title: 第15章 机会来了第16章 180岁的少女
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 芬朵娜被他的声音惊动，回过头来。
当她看到是林默时，勉强挤出一个笑容，
“没什么。”
她的声音有些沙哑，那双明亮的碧绿眼眸，此刻也显得黯淡无光。
林默三两步爬上箭塔，在她身边站定，顺着她的目光望去。
树木城墙外面，还留着大战的痕迹，地面坑坑洼洼，还有不少血迹。
至于尸体，应该是被处理了，否则留着容易造成瘟疫。
远方的地平线，被一层若有若无的黑色雾气笼罩，那是魔族大军留下的痕迹。
“是在为后面的战斗担心？”林默轻声问。
芬朵娜沉默了。
良久，她才低声开口，
“林默，你们那个世界，应该也有战争吧？”
林默耸耸肩，
“那肯定，有人的地方，就会有勾心斗角，就会有资源纷争。”
芬朵娜看向林默，认真提问：
“如果，我们当前的局面换做是你们的话，你们会怎么做？”
林默一愣，这点他还真没想过。
他想了想，按照自己从历史书和新闻里看到的逻辑，组织了一下语言。
“面对外敌入侵，还是这种压倒性局面，我想......应该会联合所有能联合的力量，一致对外吧。”
“目前来看，你们和另外三大种族，貌似都各自为战。”
芬朵娜点点头，
“是的，谁都不肯放弃自己的领土集合到一起，当然，也是怕被集中力量一锅端。”
她说着，看向城内，眼露哀伤，
“我们的战士，在上次的战斗中损失了近三成。城里的武器装备和附魔箭矢也不多了，需要重新打造。”
“魔族的攻势一次比一次猛烈，它们就像永远杀不完的蝗虫。”
“女王和长老们每天都在商议，可谁也拿不出办法。”
“我们能守住这一次，可下一次呢？下下次呢？”
“再来两次......最多两次进攻，这座城市就会失守。”
“我的父母死了，也已经死了太多的同伴了….”
说到最后，她的声音已经变成了压抑的呜咽。
看着如此可爱漂亮的妹子哭泣，林默的心脏被狠狠地揪了一下。
他看到的不只是一个女孩的脆弱，更是一个族群在毁灭边缘的绝望挣扎。
content_en:
Fendona was startled by his voice and turned around.
When she saw it was Lin Mo, she forced a smile,
"Nothing."
Her voice was a little hoarse, and her bright green eyes seemed dim at the moment.
Lin Mo climbed up the arrow tower in three or two steps, stood next to her, and followed her gaze.
Outside the trees and city walls, there are still traces of the battle. The ground is full of pits and there are a lot of blood stains.
As for the corpses, they should have been disposed of, otherwise leaving them would easily cause plague.
The distant horizon was shrouded in a layer of vague black mist, which was the trace left by the demon army.
"Are you worried about the battle ahead?" Lin Mo asked softly.
Fenduona was silent.
After a long time, she spoke in a low voice,
"Lin Mo, there should be war in your world, right?"
Lin Mo shrugged,
"That's for sure. Where there are people, there will be intrigues and disputes over resources."
Fenduona looked at Lin Mo and asked seriously:
"If our current situation were in your place, what would you do?"
Lin Mo was stunned, he really hadn't thought about this.
He thought for a while and organized the language according to the logic he saw in history books and news.
"Faced with the invasion of foreign enemies and this overwhelming situation, I think... we should unite all the forces that can be combined and attack the outside world in a unified manner."
"At present, it seems that you and the other three major races are fighting on their own."
Fenduona nodded,
"Yes, no one is willing to give up their own territory to gather together. Of course, they are also afraid of being concentrated and all will be wiped out."
She said, looking into the city with sadness in her eyes,
"Our soldiers lost nearly 30% in the last battle. There are not many weapons, equipment and enchanted arrows in the city, and they need to be rebuilt."
"The demons' attacks are becoming more fierce every time. They are like locusts that can never be killed."
"The queen and the elders are discussing every day, but no one can come up with a solution."
"We can hold on this time, but what about next time? What about next time?"
"Two more attacks...two more at most, and the city will fall."
"My parents are dead, and too many of my companions have died..."
By the end, her voice had turned into a muffled sob.
Seeing such a cute and beautiful girl crying, Lin Mo's heart was severely tugged.
What he saw was not only the fragility of a girl, but also the desperate struggle of an ethnic group on the edge of destruction.
